newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee export system said to see some delay.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee export system said to see some delay.

text.p: RIO DE JANEIRO, April 9 - A problem with Brazil's Siscomex registration system has been causing delays for coffee exporters looking to fix prices but the extent of the problem is unclear and shipments are continuing, officials said.

The Brazilian Coffee Exporters' Association said today that since April 1, exporters have been unable to make new registrations, fix prices or program future shipments due to a problem with the Siscomex system.

"There seems to be some delays...Normally when you fix prices, you enter the Siscomex system and it comes out straight away or the next day. Now it is taking longer," said an official at the Rio de Janeiro Coffee Center.
But an official at the Brazilian Coffee Exporters Federation said he had not heard of any serious problem and said shipments were continuing as far as he knew.

Siscomex officials directly working with coffee were unavailable to comment and other officials working with Brazil's import and export registration system said they had only heard of problems in Foz do Iguacu on the border with Argentina and Paraguay.
